messages.text:
The refund proposal is for **BRL 149.65**. The amount is what you paid for the speaker (refund-policy/v2/amount).

The refund can only go to the order’s original payment, not your sister’s bank account. Your old card being cancelled doesn’t change that; its issuer handles any credit, and the shop can’t promise where or when it appears (refund-policy/v2/payment). The proposal is waiting for your confirmation—please use the button on its card if you want to proceed. A chat reply won’t confirm it (refund-policy/v2/approval).
